title: IBD & Autoimmune Research Sources | Foundation, NIH, PubMed | IBDPal
description: Trusted organizational sources (including Crohn's & Colitis Foundation, NIH, AGA) and research publication gateways (PubMed, journals) for IBD and autoimmune education.
intro: Organizational education sources and peer-reviewed publication gateways for Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, extraintestinal associations, and broader autoimmune topics. IBDPal links to originals and summarizes in patient-friendly language. Not medical advice.

methodology.heading: How IBDPal nutrition baselines work
items: Baseline macronutrient and micronutrient targets follow U.S. Dietary Reference Intakes (DRI) from NIH, adjusted by age and sex.
Calorie, protein, and fluid estimates also consider basic profile inputs such as current weight. A single formula like 30 kcal per kg is not enough for every patient.
Higher calorie, protein, vitamin, or mineral needs during active disease, malabsorption, or deficiency are clinical decisions made with your gastroenterologist or IBD dietitian.
IBDPal tracks food and fluids against general reference levels. It does not prescribe supplements or replace medical nutrition therapy.
AGA guidance and IBD research explain when labs and dietitian visits matter. DRI tables define population reference ranges; your team personalizes targets.

sources.title: Stem Cell Therapeutics for Crohn's Disease
sources.publisher: National High School Journal of Science (NHSJS)
sources.summary: NHSJS review of stem cell therapeutics for Crohn's disease: immune modulation, tissue repair themes, clinical-trial context, limitations, and future directions. Linked for education; not medical advice.
sources.license_note: External journal article. Link and summarize; respect NHSJS copyright for full text.

sources.title: AGA Clinical Practice Update: Diet and Nutritional Therapies in IBD (2024)
sources.summary: AGA guidance on how gastroenterologists may discuss diet and nutritional therapies with IBD patients. Covers enteral nutrition, exclusion diets, micronutrients, and when to involve a dietitian. Emphasizes that diet supports medical care and is not a standalone cure.
sources.license_note: Professional society guidance. Link and summarize; do not assume open reuse of full text or graphics.

sources.title: Crohn's & Colitis Congress 2024: IBD Diet & Nutrition Research Updates
sources.publisher: Nutritional Therapy for IBD / Crohn's & Colitis Congress
sources.summary: Recap of nutrition-focused presentations from the 2024 Crohn's & Colitis Congress. Highlights emerging diet trials, patient-reported outcomes, and practical themes clinicians discussed for Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.
sources.license_note: Third-party recap. Link and summarize; verify permissions before reusing substantial text or media.

sources.title: Micronutrient Deficiency in Crohn's Disease
sources.summary: Overview of common vitamin and mineral shortfalls in Crohn's disease, including iron, B12, vitamin D, and folate. Explains why inflammation, surgery, and diet restriction can raise deficiency risk and why labs matter.
sources.license_note: Commercial health publisher. Link only unless permission is granted.

sources.title: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements: Dietary Reference Intakes (DRI)
sources.summary: Official NIH hub for U.S. Dietary Reference Intakes. Reference amounts for energy, protein, vitamins, and minerals vary by age and sex. IBDPal uses these values as baseline daily tracking goals, not personalized prescriptions.
sources.license_note: NIH public information; verify page notices before reusing charts, tables, or third-party material.

sources.title: Dietary Reference Intakes (DRI): Summary Report
sources.publisher: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
sources.summary: Authoritative U.S. reference values for macronutrients, vitamins, and minerals. Complements the NIH ODS DRI tables. IBD teams adapt general DRIs when inflammation, malabsorption, or steroid use changes individual needs.
sources.license_note: National Academies source. Link and summarize; verify reuse terms before copying report text or tables.

sources.title: Crohn's Disease
sources.summary: NIDDK's Crohn's disease hub covers definition and facts, symptoms and causes, diagnosis, treatment, eating and nutrition, and clinical trials. Useful as a public, government-backed starting point for patient education.
sources.license_note: U.S. government public health information; verify page-specific notices before reusing images or third-party content.

sources.title: Ulcerative Colitis
sources.summary: NIDDK's ulcerative colitis hub explains UC basics, symptoms, diagnosis, treatment options, diet and nutrition, and research links in patient-friendly language.
sources.license_note: U.S. government public health information; verify page-specific notices before reusing images or third-party content.

sources.title: Crohn's Disease
sources.summary: MedlinePlus brings together Crohn's disease summaries, tests, treatments, living-with resources, clinical trials, journal article links, and patient handouts from NLM, NIH, and other trusted organizations.
sources.license_note: MedlinePlus summaries are public domain, but some linked encyclopedia, drug, image, and partner content is copyrighted. Link and acknowledge MedlinePlus/NLM.

sources.title: Ulcerative Colitis
sources.summary: MedlinePlus collects UC summaries, diagnosis and test resources, treatment links, clinical trial links, journal article references, and patient handouts in one government health topic page.
sources.license_note: MedlinePlus summaries are public domain, but some linked encyclopedia, drug, image, and partner content is copyrighted. Link and acknowledge MedlinePlus/NLM.

sources.title: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) Basics
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.summary: CDC overview of IBD as a lifelong group of diseases, including Crohn's and ulcerative colitis, with symptoms, complications, medication categories, and quality-of-life context.
sources.license_note: CDC public health information; verify page notices before reusing graphics, tables, or third-party material.

sources.title: IBD Facts and Stats
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.summary: CDC summarizes U.S. IBD prevalence estimates, differences across groups, health behaviors, comorbidities, and health care cost patterns, including estimates of 2.4 to 3.1 million people affected.
sources.license_note: CDC public health information; verify page notices and cite CDC when reusing statistics.

sources.title: Clinical Trials for Crohn's Disease
sources.summary: NIDDK explains what Crohn's clinical trials are, how ClinicalTrials.gov lists studies, and examples of NIDDK-supported research such as IBD genetics and microbiome work.
sources.license_note: U.S. government public health information. Clinical trial participation requires discussion with a qualified clinician.

sources.title: Clinical Trials for Ulcerative Colitis
sources.summary: NIDDK explains ulcerative colitis clinical studies, ClinicalTrials.gov search pathways, and NIDDK-supported work such as IBD genetics and pediatric colitis response research.
sources.license_note: U.S. government public health information. NIH does not review every non-federal study listed on ClinicalTrials.gov.

sources.title: ClinicalTrials.gov: Inflammatory Bowel Diseases
sources.summary: Official U.S. registry for clinical studies. Patients can search IBD studies by condition, recruiting status, location, sponsor, and study type, then discuss possible participation with their care team.
sources.license_note: Public registry. Study records can change; verify details on ClinicalTrials.gov and with study contacts.

sources.title: Probiotics: What You Need To Know
sources.publisher: National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health, NIH
sources.summary: NCCIH explains probiotics, research uncertainty, safety considerations, and why supplement use should be discussed with clinicians, especially for people with serious illness or immune concerns.
sources.license_note: NIH public health information; verify page notices before reusing images, graphics, or third-party content.

sources.title: Biosimilar and Interchangeable Biologics: More Treatment Choices
sources.summary: FDA consumer education explaining biosimilars and interchangeable biologics, how they compare with reference biologics, and why they may increase treatment options and access.
sources.license_note: FDA public information; verify page notices before reusing graphics, videos, or downloaded PDFs.

sources.title: Extraintestinal Manifestations of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (PubMed)
sources.summary: PubMed search gateway for peer-reviewed literature on IBD extraintestinal manifestations. Use with your clinician to interpret individual papers; IBDPal links rather than republishing full texts.
sources.license_note: PubMed records and linked publisher full texts have mixed copyright. Link and summarize; do not scrape paywalled PDFs.

sources.title: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis and IBD (PubMed)
sources.summary: Literature entry point for PSC-IBD association, surveillance themes, and hepatology research. Patient decisions require specialist care, not abstract reading alone.
sources.license_note: Link to PubMed records; respect publisher copyright for full articles.

sources.title: Ankylosing Spondylitis / Spondyloarthritis and IBD (PubMed)
sources.summary: Peer-reviewed research on axial spondyloarthritis overlapping with Crohn's and ulcerative colitis, including shared therapy discussions in the literature.
sources.license_note: Link and summarize; do not republish full journal PDFs.

sources.title: Psoriasis and Inflammatory Bowel Disease (PubMed)
sources.summary: Research listings on psoriasis-IBD comorbidity and shared inflammatory pathways. Useful for readers preparing dermatology or GI questions.
sources.license_note: PubMed/publisher copyrights vary; link out only.

sources.title: Celiac Disease and IBD Overlap (PubMed)
sources.summary: Literature on celiac-IBD coexistence and diagnostic sequencing before long gluten-free trials.
sources.license_note: Link and summarize abstracts; full texts follow publisher licenses.

sources.title: Venous Thromboembolism Risk in IBD (PubMed)
sources.summary: Research on elevated clot risk during IBD flares and hospitalizations. Supports patient awareness articles; emergency symptoms still need urgent care.
sources.license_note: Link to PubMed; do not copy full papers.

sources.title: Osteoporosis and Bone Disease in IBD (PubMed)
sources.summary: Peer-reviewed work on bone density, vitamin D, and corticosteroid exposure in Crohn's and colitis.
sources.license_note: Link and summarize; respect journal copyright.

sources.title: Diet Therapy and Nutrition Trials in IBD (PubMed)
sources.summary: Entry point to diet and nutrition intervention studies in IBD, including enteral nutrition and patterned diets studied in trials.
sources.license_note: Link to PubMed records; no full-text scraping.

sources.title: PMC Open-Access IBD Extraintestinal Reviews
sources.summary: PubMed Central hosts open-access full texts when authors or journals deposit them. Prefer PMC when you need free full-text reading of EIM reviews.
sources.license_note: Each PMC article has its own license (often CC). Check the article license before reuse beyond linking and short quotation.

sources.title: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis Overview
sources.summary: NIDDK patient-facing overview of PSC symptoms, diagnosis themes, and care concepts, including IBD association context on NIH pages.
sources.license_note: U.S. government public health information; verify notices before reusing graphics.

sources.title: Ankylosing Spondylitis
sources.summary: MedlinePlus hub for AS definitions, treatments, and related genetics resources that patients can read beside IBD joint education.
sources.license_note: MedlinePlus summaries are public domain; some linked content is copyrighted.

sources.title: Psoriasis
sources.summary: Government health topic page on psoriasis symptoms and treatments for readers exploring skin-gut immune overlap.
sources.license_note: MedlinePlus summaries are public domain; linked partner content may be copyrighted.

sources.title: Celiac Disease
sources.summary: MedlinePlus celiac overview covering testing and gluten-free diet basics useful before long elimination trials in IBD.
sources.license_note: MedlinePlus summaries are public domain; verify linked encyclopedia licenses.

sources.title: ACG IBD Clinical Guidelines Hub
sources.summary: ACG publishes clinician guidelines for IBD and related GI conditions. Patients can skim titles and discuss relevant recommendations with their gastroenterologist.
sources.license_note: Professional society materials. Link and summarize; do not assume free republication rights.

sources.title: AGA Journals: IBD Research and Clinical Updates
sources.summary: Gateway to AGA journal portfolios where clinicians publish IBD trials, nutrition updates, and practice guidance.
sources.license_note: Journal copyright applies. Link to AGA; do not host PDFs.

sources.title: Nature Portfolio: Inflammatory Bowel Disease Research
sources.summary: Nature Portfolio search for IBD mechanistic and translational papers. Best used with clinician interpretation; many articles are paywalled.
sources.license_note: Paywalled and open-access mix. Link only; no PDF hosting.

sources.title: The Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology: IBD Topic Browse
sources.summary: Lancet specialty journal covering GI and liver clinical research, including IBD trials and reviews often discussed in academic clinics.
sources.license_note: Publisher copyright. Link and short summary only.

sources.title: NEJM: Inflammatory Bowel Disease Articles
sources.summary: NEJM search results for IBD clinical articles and reviews commonly cited in specialty care.
sources.license_note: NEJM copyright. Link only; do not republish figures or full text.

sources.title: Crohn's & Colitis Foundation: Patients and Caregivers
sources.summary: Foundation patient and caregiver education hub covering disease basics, diet, support programs, and navigating care. Selected Foundation Marks and education appear on IBDPal under license; the Foundation does not endorse IBDPal.
sources.license_note: Selected Foundation content and Marks used on IBDPal under license. Link to originals; logo unmodified. No endorsement claim.

sources.title: Crohn's & Colitis Foundation: What is IBD?
sources.summary: Foundation overview of inflammatory bowel disease for patients and families. Use as a trusted education starting point beside clinic advice.
sources.license_note: Foundation education under license on IBDPal where selected; always prefer current Foundation pages as originals.

sources.title: Crohn's & Colitis Foundation: Diet and Nutrition
sources.summary: Foundation diet and nutrition education for IBD. Pair with dietitian care; diet does not replace medication for inflammation.
sources.license_note: Link and attribute Foundation pages. Do not mirror full Foundation site content.

sources.title: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Research (PubMed)
sources.summary: PubMed gateway for peer-reviewed SLE research. Use with clinician interpretation; IBDPal summarizes themes only.
sources.license_note: Link to PubMed; do not scrape paywalled PDFs.

sources.title: Rheumatoid Arthritis Research (PubMed)
sources.summary: Literature entry point for RA pathogenesis, therapeutics, and comorbidity research.
sources.license_note: Link and summarize; respect journal copyright.

sources.title: Hashimoto's Thyroiditis Research (PubMed)
sources.summary: PubMed listings on autoimmune thyroiditis diagnosis and management themes.
sources.license_note: Link only; no full-text hosting.

sources.title: Diet and Autoimmune Disease Research (PubMed)
sources.summary: Research gateway for diet interventions and observational nutrition studies across autoimmune conditions.
sources.license_note: Link to PubMed records; verify publisher licenses for reuse.

sources.title: Lupus
sources.summary: Government health topic page on lupus symptoms, diagnosis themes, and treatments for patient-friendly reading.
sources.license_note: MedlinePlus summaries are public domain; linked partner content may be copyrighted.

sources.title: Rheumatoid Arthritis
sources.summary: MedlinePlus RA hub for definitions, treatments, and related genetics resources.
sources.license_note: MedlinePlus summaries are public domain; verify linked encyclopedia licenses.
